findings.problem: `unitPullback` is additive in `z`, and this is the canonical rewrite for `unitPullback ... (z - z')`. The definition file gives no additivity lemma, no `_zero` and no `_sub` lemma, and none of its API is tagged `@[simp]`. So each downstream file proves the lemma again as a private local helper. Besides this file's `P5Red.unitPullback_sub`, there are `Ws23Cech.unitPullback_sub` and `Ws23Cech.unitPullback_zero` in S_AlgebraicGeometry_OModulePresheaf_unitPullback_comp_sub_unitPullback_id_mem.lean, plus `ounitPullback_sub` in another file. In this file the lemma is only usable by passing it by hand as an argument to `assemble`, because no simp lemma or `map_sub`-style instance lets `simp` or `rw [map_sub]` push `unitPullback` through subtraction. The `_apply_of_injective` lemmas are also not simp lemmas, so they have to be rewritten by hand three times in the proof.
findings.proposed_change: Put the additivity lemmas next to `unitPullback` in Def_AlgebraicGeometry_OrderedAffineCoverCochainPullback.lean. That means `unitPullback_zero`, `unitPullback_sub` and `unitPullback_add`, tagged `@[simp]` (the forms `unitPullback .. 0 = 0` and `unitPullback .. (z - z') = unitPullback .. z - unitPullback .. z'` push the function inward and keep the left side as the head symbol). Alternatively, package `unitPullback` as an `AddMonoidHom` or linear map so that `map_sub` and `map_zero` apply. Then delete the local copies in this file and in the `Ws23Cech` file.
findings.benefit: Every user gets one canonical normal form, with `unitPullback` pushed inside sums and differences, instead of several differently-parameterised copies. The proofs that use `unitPullback` can then close with `simp` or `map_sub`.
